message Outcome {
	required binary entity_key (STRING);
	required binary kind (STRING);
	required binary value (STRING);
	required int64 occurred_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MICROS));
	required int64 observed_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MICROS));
	required binary source (STRING);
}
